claim.claim-text: 4. The rapid drying and differential pressure measuring device for the exhaust gas reducer of claim 1, further comprising: a 3-way valve (27) provided in the first air supply part (25a); a branched pipe (28) connected to the 3-way valve (27); and an end portion differential air pressure sensor (29) connected to the branched pipe (28) to measure a differential pressure of the exhaust gas reducer (1) for the commercial vehicle.

5. The rapid drying and differential pressure measuring device for the exhaust gas reducer of claim 1, further comprising: a coupling pipe body (36) coupled to an air supply hole (23a) of the upper adapter (23); a connection pipe (37) connected to the coupling pipe body (36); and a differential pressure measurement adapter (38) coupled to the connection pipe (37) to be connected to an air supply pipe (6a) or exhaust pipe (6b) of the exhaust gas reducer (5) for a passenger vehicle.
